call_points.text: Management said FY27 EBITDA margin can improve over FY26, when asked to confirm the assumption.
Reiterated the ₹4,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr profit milestone by 2028.
R&D budget for this year guided at ₹180-200 Cr, up from ₹160 Cr last year.
Destiny deals crossed 100 for the first time, with seven converted in the quarter.
Purple Fabric cumulative spend is over ₹700-800 Cr over eight years, about ₹100 Cr a year.
Purple Fabric will remain a separate line of business; management said there are no demerger plans.
Management acknowledged clients building software in-house with AI is a trend, but expects most to return to vendors.
Purple Fabric internal pilot shows potential to cut development effort by 60%, which management flagged as a risk for IT services.

operating_notes.text: Khalsa Credit Union, BC, Canada, with over $920 million in assets and branches in Surrey, Abbotsford, Victoria and Vancouver, selected Intellect's eMACH.ai Digital Engagement Platform; value not disclosed.
eMACH.ai Payments received highest rating from Nacha Consulting across TCH RTP, FedNow, Fedwire, and ACH rails in April 2026.
Intellect named a Leader in Gartner Magic Quadrant for Banking Payment Hub Platforms in January 2026.
Platform serves 126+ financial institution clients globally across 40 countries.
Ayeyarwady Farmers Development Bank Public Company Limited (A bank PCL) selected Intellect's eMACH.ai Core Banking, PF Credit and AI First Lending solutions.
Board recommended final dividend of ₹4 and special dividend of ₹3 per share for FY26.
FY26 Total Income reached ₹3,161 Cr with license-linked revenue at ₹1,667 Cr.
Mainstreet Credit Union selected Intellect's eMACH.ai Digital Engagement Platform for its 25,300+ members.
VantageOne Credit Union selected Intellect's eMACH.ai Lending and PF Credit platforms.
37 Canadian financial institutions managing over $11.7B CAD in assets selected Intellect's eMACH.ai DEP platform.
AU Small Finance Bank adopted Intellect's Purple Fabric platform and PF Credit agents for AI-first banking.
Purple Fabric recognized as a notable vendor in Forrester's AI Platforms Landscape, Q1 2026, with over 40 regulated financial institution deployments.
Launched AI Digital Banking platform for UK & Europe-based digital and challenger banks on June 2, 2026.
Pipeline grew 15% YoY to ₹13,000 Cr, with 19 strategic wins and 16 transformations completed in Q1FY27.
Destiny deals crossed 100, with seven converted in the quarter; deal-size band includes about 29 deals of around ₹50 Cr.
Purple Fabric internal pilot reached 78 projects between 15 May and 15 July 2026, with early signs of up to 60% effort reduction.
Deployed eMACH.ai Lending Platform for Jameel Finance - Egypt within 16 weeks.
Total pipeline value stood at ₹13,125 Cr, containing 103 Destiny-class pursuits across deal bands.
LTM license-linked revenue reached ₹1,768 Cr, up 18% YoY.

timeline.summary: On 21 April 2026, Intellect Design Arena announced a strategic partnership with Khalsa Credit Union, BC, Canada, which will adopt its eMACH.ai Digital Engagement Platform; no deal value was disclosed.
Intellect Design Arena's eMACH.ai Payments platform received the highest compliance rating from Nacha Consulting across all four major US payment rails.
Intellect Design Arena secured a deal from Myanmar's Ayeyarwady Farmers Development Bank for eMACH.ai Core Banking and AI lending solutions.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹847.02 Cr (+16.7% YoY), net profit ₹120.22 Cr (-11.9% YoY).
Intellect Design Arena released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation on May 8, 2026, reporting 23% YoY growth in total income and recommending a final and special dividend.
Intellect Design Arena Limited recorded its earnings call for quarter and FY ended March 31, 2026, on May 8, 2026.
Intellect Design Arena secured a deal with Mainstreet Credit Union for its eMACH.ai Digital Engagement Platform.
VantageOne Credit Union selected Intellect's eMACH.ai Lending and PF Credit platforms to modernize its lending operations.
Intellect Design Arena was selected by 37 Canadian credit unions managing over $11.7 billion CAD in assets for digital banking transformation using eMACH.ai DEP.
Intellect Design Arena announced that AU Small Finance Bank adopted its Purple Fabric AI platform and PF Credit agents.
Intellect Design Arena announced its recognition as a notable vendor in Forrester's AI Platforms Landscape, Q1 2026, for its Purple Fabric platform.
On June 2, 2026, Intellect Design Arena launched its AI Digital Banking platform for UK and European challenger banks.

On 31 July 2026 Intellect Design Arena's Q1FY27 earnings call reported total income up 19% YoY to ₹872 Cr, EBITDA of ₹194 Cr and cash of ₹1,269 Cr, with management guiding to FY27 EBITDA margin improvement.
Intellect Design Arena successfully deployed its eMACH.ai Lending Platform for Jameel Finance - Egypt in 16 weeks.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹846.73 Cr (+11.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹104.12 Cr.
Intellect Design Arena reported Q2 FY27 total income of ₹878 Cr and PAT of ₹104 Cr, with pipeline value reaching ₹13,125 Cr.
Prakash Bharadwaj (ACS-37214) announced the Q2 FY2026-27 earnings call recording is available on the company’s website.
